meta.title: Double Color Ball Draws
meta.description: Query past Double Color Ball draws (2013+, winners and prize per tier) and keep them in a local archive; on draw nights (Tue/Thu/Sun 21:35 Asia/Shanghai) it fetches automatically and retries at +5/+15/+45 minutes and 06:00 the next morning when the draw is not out yet. Where: Settings → Double Color Ball sets the cadence; enable in a conversation with /ssq-watch on|off|status (or the ssq_watch_enable tool) and the fetched data is delivered back to that conversation. Every check pulls the full official snapshot (~21 requests, ~3 s). Requires dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.5; archiving a Session also deletes its reminders.
